entities.name: Viking Age & the Livonians
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Curonian pirates and Viking-age trade along the Daugava. The Finno-Ugric Livonians at the mouth of the Daugava, early contacts with Scandinavian and Rus' merchants, and the first German missionary attempts by Meinhard of Segeberg (c. 1184).
